incidents.attacker: China — state-backed cyber contractor (Integrity Technology Group)
incidents.vector: Automated vulnerability scanning via MicroScan tool and spearphishing via FishHub tool, both operated through a Mirai-variant IoT botnet
incidents.impact: Persistent access established across US government, manufacturing, healthcare and critical infrastructure globally; confirmed victims include a South Carolina power company, airports in Poland and Japan, and Taiwanese gas, power and university networks; DOJ and FBI seized MicroScan and FishHub tools in court-authorized action

incidents.vector: Unencrypted military personnel records shared via insecure file-sharing system for nine months without authorization or detection
incidents.impact: 2.8 million+ active duty and reserve military personnel records exposed for nine months (Oct 2025–Jul 2026); data includes PII and service records; extent of unauthorized external access not yet confirmed

incidents.victim: ATNS (Air Traffic and Navigation Services, South Africa)
incidents.vector: Ransomware deployed against air traffic management systems including operational technology (OT) network
incidents.impact: Air traffic OT systems encrypted causing a near-miss for air safety at South African airports; flight management disrupted; underscores critical infrastructure OT exposure to ransomware

incidents.vector: Data theft from healthcare provider systems (specific vector not publicly disclosed)
incidents.impact: 5 million+ patient records stolen in one of the largest healthcare data breaches in Polish history; data includes personal and medical information

incidents.victim: Internet users in Ghana, Sierra Leone and American Samoa
incidents.vector: Compromise of country-code top-level domain (ccTLD) registrars for .gh, .sl and .as; DNS manipulated to obtain fraudulent TLS certificates
incidents.impact: TLS certificates fraudulently obtained for domains in three countries including local Google services; Google Chrome blocklisted affected certificates; users potentially exposed to phishing and malware redirection during the window of compromise

incidents.vector: Ransomware-as-a-service attacks across multiple industries; three core members arrested in coordinated Europol operation
incidents.impact: KillSec ransomware group dismantled by Europol with three arrests; group had conducted 1,000+ attacks against victims worldwide before takedown; infrastructure seized

incidents.vector: Social engineering of an employee via impersonation of a trusted contact; credentials used to access third-party cloud platforms including a claimed Snowflake data environment
incidents.impact: Personal data of up to 17 million customers potentially exposed including names and contact details; ASOS shares fell 10%+ on the London Stock Exchange; attackers pushed an unauthorized breach notification to customers via the official ASOS app

incidents.victim: Open-source software ecosystem (Axios, Mastra AI, Rust arrayref)
incidents.vector: Malicious packages injected into npm, Go and Rust package registries using blockchain-based Web3 command-and-control to evade detection
incidents.impact: Trusted open-source packages including Axios, Mastra AI and Rust arrayref compromised with backdoors; developers installing affected packages exposed to credential theft and cryptocurrency theft

incidents.vector: Exploitation of an unpatched Oracle software vulnerability via an Accenture contractor account on FBIjobs.gov
incidents.impact: Sensitive data on nearly every FBI employee stolen including medical records, home addresses and phone numbers; thousands of local police task force records exposed; FBI Director confirmed multiple arrests; at least three members detained in the US, Netherlands and Jordan

incidents.vector: AI-assisted attack using ARTEX framework with Claude as the orchestrating AI agent; investigators recovered the attacker's Claude.md configuration and full chat history from a compromised system
incidents.impact: Multiple South Korean financial institutions successfully breached; first documented recovery of an attacker's AI agent configuration from a live incident, confirming AI tools are being weaponized by low-sophistication threat actors

incidents.vector: DNS and HTTP traffic manipulation within hotel and conference venue networks to intercept credentials and communications of targeted travelers
incidents.impact: Credentials and sensitive communications of government officials, executives and other high-value travelers harvested at international hospitality venues; persistent espionage access maintained across multiple locations

incidents.victim: Ukrainian transport, manufacturing and energy organizations
incidents.vector: Spear-phishing campaigns delivering MatchBoil malware targeting organizations in Ukrainian transport, manufacturing and energy sectors
incidents.impact: Persistent credential theft and espionage operations against Ukrainian critical infrastructure sectors; campaign active since 2024 with no confirmed disruption to the threat actor

incidents.vector: AI-assisted spear-phishing with Google Adversary-in-the-Middle (AitM) credential harvesting infrastructure
incidents.impact: Researchers and academics in Taiwan targeted for credential theft and intellectual property exfiltration; AI-enhanced lures significantly increased phishing effectiveness against high-value targets

incidents.victim: Government and policy organizations (Taiwan, India, Philippines, Cambodia)
incidents.vector: Antino backdoor delivered via targeted phishing against government and policy organizations across Asia-Pacific
incidents.impact: Persistent espionage access established across government and policy organizations in four Asia-Pacific nations; classified and sensitive policy information at risk

incidents.victim: Global enterprise networks (50,000+ Citrix NetScaler instances)
incidents.vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerabilities CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 in Citrix NetScaler for remote code execution and web shell deployment
incidents.impact: 50,000+ NetScaler instances exposed; persistent web shell backdoors deployed across enterprise networks; full scope of affected organizations not yet determined

incidents.vector: Theft from exchange hot wallets (specific attack vector not publicly disclosed)
incidents.impact: $350 million stolen from Bitget hot wallets; largest single cryptocurrency exchange theft of 2026; funds tracked via blockchain analytics

incidents.victim: Yoido Full Gospel Church (850K members) and SaRang Church (89K members), South Korea
incidents.vector: Web shell implanted on church server for admin-level access; second church breached via leaked passwords and SAP enterprise application vulnerabilities
incidents.impact: 850,000+ congregant records exposed at Yoido Full Gospel Church including financial and personal data; 89,000+ member records and 286 staff files stolen at SaRang Church; attackers leveraged AI tools for network traversal and data extraction

incidents.victim: Global organizations (86,644 FortiGate VPN devices across 194 countries)
incidents.vector: Credential stuffing against FortiGate SSL VPN followed by GPU-accelerated password hash cracking; compromised credentials sold to ransomware affiliates as initial access packages
incidents.impact: 86,644 FortiGate devices compromised across 194 countries; stolen credentials sold to ransomware operators creating significant downstream ransomware exposure for thousands of organizations

incidents.vector: Social engineering attack on third-party hosted business applications; threat actor demanded payment to suppress stolen data
incidents.impact: 360,000+ cardiac patients' personal information stolen including patient account numbers, device serial numbers and insurance data; extortion demand made and disclosed in SEC 8-K filing; clinical systems and medical devices not affected

incidents.vector: ShelbyLoader V2 malware with GitHub repositories used as command-and-control (Blinder Tunnel technique) to blend malicious traffic with legitimate web traffic
incidents.impact: Persistent access established in Iraqi telecom and aviation critical infrastructure; data exfiltrated from government-linked networks in a sustained espionage campaign

incidents.vector: AI-generated voice deepfake impersonating a senior bank executive used to authorize fraudulent wire transfers
incidents.impact: €95 million in fraudulent wire transfers executed; €36 million remains unrecovered; one of the largest AI-enabled financial fraud cases in European banking history

incidents.vector: Undisclosed initial access; administrator-level control obtained over Moscow healthcare network infrastructure connected to multiple other government agencies
incidents.impact: Full administrative access to Moscow Department of Health maintained for months; sensitive medical data accessed including records assessed to contain Russian military casualty information; group claims current access to hundreds of Russian and Belarusian IT systems
